draftedFindings.title: first panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body: Slicing with `[..n]` panics if `n > items.len()`, so callers passing a count larger than the input length will crash. The existing `last` helper handles this case by returning the whole slice when there are fewer than `n` items; `first` should similarly clamp the end index, e.g. `&items[..items.len().min(n)]`, unless panicking is an explicit part of the API contract.
